data.body: AC amendment (gap G7): Seed-target lookup must be O(1) not O(M). In _emit() helper, convert seed_mutations targets to a frozenset at differ entry: `_seed_targets = frozenset(m.target for m in seed_mutations or [])`. _emit() then checks `if mutation.target in _seed_targets` — O(1) lookup. Add unit test asserting performance characteristic (count membership operations OR enforce data type).
